headlines.text: On this day in 2025, history was made as Mercedes Mone vs. Red Velvet contested the very first ROH Women's TV Title match, appearing on Collision, rated 7.13 ? a well-worked match. Mon? defeated Red Velvet to unify the ROH Women's World Television Championship, continuing an unprecedented run that made her the first wrestler to hold this many titles across three promotions simultaneously.
Looking back to 2021, when Cole & Fish skipped the warm-up and went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.95.
Turning the clock back to 2025: Adam Page vs. Katsuyori Shibata headlined Dynamite, rated 7.03 ? a well-worked match.

secondaries.text: On a Friday in 2021, back when Red Velvet stepped back through the curtain after just under 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.

Back on this day in 2025, Jon Moxley reached a genuinely rare feat of endurance: their 200th match in AEW, facing Castagnoli & Moxley vs. Cassidy & Strong on Dynamite, rated 6.66 in a physical tag team battle.
It was 2025 when Young Bucks & Alexander vs. SkyFlight locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 6.56.
